reference.code: fn nums(s:&str)->Option<Vec<i32>>{if s.is_empty(){return None}let mut o=vec![];for z in s.split(','){let x:i32=z.parse().ok()?;if x.to_string()!=z||x< -1000||x>1000{return None}o.push(x)}Some(o)}fn join(a:&[i32])->String{a.iter().map(|x|x.to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(",")}pub fn strict_prefix_records(s:&str)->Option<String>{let a=nums(s)?;let mut m=None;Some(a.into_iter().filter(|x|if m.is_none_or(|v|*x>v){m=Some(*x);true}else{false}).map(|x|x.to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(","))}
